item.isekai_mahou.quincy_archmage_chestp: Winged Mantle of the Sacred Form
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_spirit_bow.des: Quincy FORM: fires arrows of blue Reishi — fast, straight and weightless — that apply the effects. Split = fan (each arrow is a copy). Auswählen rank II: they pierce +1 target.
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_hirenkyaku.des: Quincy FORM: glide on a trail of Reishi up to 6 blocks (+2 per Expand) and apply the effects to everyone you pass. Works with no effects (movement only).
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_seele_blade.de: Quincy FORM: a blade of Reishi slashes a 120° arc in front of you (3.5 blocks) at 80%% power — a Quincy is no swordsman.
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_absorb.desc: Quincy FORM: for 3 s a field swallows enemy projectiles and spells and pulls energy from anyone inside; at the end it RETURNS everything as up to 8 arrows carrying the effects.
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_light_rain.des: Quincy FORM (Circle 3): a star opens in the sky above the aimed point and 6 arrows fall from it (+2 per Split/Expand, max 16), each carrying the effects.
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_vollstandig.de: TRANSFORMATION BODY (Quincy, Circle 6). Goes inside the Supreme Transformation (G key): Supreme Transformation → Vollständig → effects. Wings of light and a halo for 12 s (Extend on the body increases it): you glide, resist, swallow projectiles, and every second the halo fires at up to 4 enemies (+Split) with the spell's effects.
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_drain_reishi.d: Quincy EFFECT: light damage that steals the target's energy — you recover Focus and store 1 Reishi; enemy players lose mana.
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_release.desc: Quincy EFFECT: spends ALL stored Reishi and returns it as damage (3 + 1.2 per charge, up to 20 charges). Copies of the same spell share the cost.
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_blut.desc: Quincy EFFECT (beneficial): Reishi in the veins — Resistance and Absorption for 8 s. Invert: unstable veins in the enemy (Weakness and damage).
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_schrift.desc: Quincy EFFECT (Circle 4): the power of YOUR Letter — E explodes, I strikes like iron, T chains shocks, W hurls away, F spreads fear. No Letter: Reishi damage only.
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_silver_tube.de: Quincy AUGMENT: when cast, spends 1 Silver Ampoule from your inventory and the spell gains +35%% power (no Ampoule, no cast).
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.explode.desc: Each Schrift hit marks the target, which detonates in Reishi 1 s later (radius 2.5) without breaking blocks.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.explode.passi: Passive: enemies defeated by Quincy techniques explode (2 damage around).
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.iron.desc: Your Schrift becomes a heavy, pushing blow, and your body hardens (Resistance I for 3 s).
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.iron.passive: Passive: +2 armor and −10%% of all damage taken.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.thunder.desc: Your Schrift shocks the target and a bolt of Reishi jumps to 2 nearby enemies.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.thunder.passi: Passive: Cross arrows have a 20%% chance to Shock.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.wind.desc: Your Schrift hurls the target up and away, and you gain Speed II for 3 s.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.wind.passive: Passive: +8%% speed and Flying Step goes 2 blocks farther.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.fear.desc: Your Schrift paralyzes with fear: Slowness II and Weakness for 4 s; creatures drop you and back off.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.fear.passive: Passive: monsters targeting you sometimes hesitate (Slowness for 1 s).
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.release_empt: No stored Reishi: Reishi Return comes out weak. Absorb projectiles or drain enemies.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.no_tube: No Silver Ampoule in your inventory!
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.welcome: The world's Reishi answers you. Draw the Quincy Cross to form the Spirit Bow; absorb what comes at you and return it twofold. See the Quincy tab in the menu (B).
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.not_quincy: Only a Quincy may walk the Auswählen.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.max_rank: You have already reached the Sacred Form (rank V).
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.rank_up_anno: %s absorbed the power of the Quincy and became %s!
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.rank_up: Auswählen rank %s: %s! +%s XP. New techniques were written into your Grimoire.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.rank_ready: Auswählen rank %s is ready! Open the Quincy tab (B) to perform it.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.choose_lette: A Letter awakens in you... Choose your Schrift in the Quincy tab of the menu (B).
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.letter_locke: The Letter only awakens at Auswählen rank III.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.letter_alrea: Your Letter has already been chosen — it is forever.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.outfit_equip: The new outfit is already worn (the old pieces went to your inventory).
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.outfit_inven: The new outfit is in your inventory.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.npc_yield_qu: %s yields. Click them to perform the Auswählen!
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.npc_yield_ot: %s yields and offers Silver Ampoules as tribute.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.npc_not_quin: "You won... but only a Quincy can receive my power."
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.auswahlen_bu: You are already performing an Auswählen.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.auswahlen_ta: Another Quincy is already absorbing that power.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.auswahlen_be: Auswählen... stay close to %s while the light flows into you.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.auswahlen_to: Too far: the flow of Reishi fell apart.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.auswahlen_do: The power of %s is now yours. Auswählen: %s · +%s XP.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.auswahlen_ta: %s has already given their power today (once per day).
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.auswahlen_pe: The request was already sent; wait for an answer.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.auswahlen_ac: Give your power: you gain XP, but lose your Reishi, half your Focus and get Weakness for 1 minute.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.auswahlen_re: %s wants to perform the Auswählen on you.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.auswahlen_no: Nobody asked you for the Auswählen (or the request expired).
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.auswahlen_pl: You gave your power to %s. Your Reishi will return in time.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.cmd_letter_u: Unknown letter. Use: explode, iron, thunder, wind or fear.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.status_ready: Rank %s is ready! Perform it in the Quincy tab (B).
tooltip.isekai_mahou.quincy_outfit_flavo: White as the light you shoot; the blue cross on the chest keeps the first oath.
Spirit silver on the cuffs and cap: Hollows learn to fear its gleam.
The hood of the Star Knights and the five-pointed star on the cape: the Letter burns in you.
Wings of light and a halo that never fades. Vollständig — the sacred form.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.quincy_outfit.set: Full set: Armor %s · +%s Focus · +%s%% regeneration · +%s%% speed · +%s%% Spell Power
tooltip.isekai_mahou.quincy_outfit.gift: Given to every Quincy on reaching Circle %s.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.quincy_cross: Draw it to form the Spirit Bow: arrows of Reishi, no ammo.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.quincy_cross.burst: Sneaking, fully drawn and with %s stored Reishi: Holy Burst of 5 arrows.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.quincy_cross.gather: Holding the Cross: +25%% Focus regeneration; standing still gathers Reishi from the surroundings.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.quincy_cross.auswah: Sneak + click a Quincy player: request the Auswählen.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.quincy_seele_schnei: A blade of Reishi: quick and light, but weaker than steel.
A Quincy's strikes return Focus and sometimes store Reishi.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.quincy_silver_tube: Liquid Reishi in a silver tube, ready to be released.
Spent by spells with the "Silver Ampoule" augment (+35%% power).
Reishi is in everything: the wind, the stones, even you. A Quincy only needs to know how to ask... and draw.
I've trained here since I was a child. A thousand arrows a day, and not one made of wood.
Hollows fear our light. They know nothing we absorb ever goes back to them.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.quincy.npc.sentine: I stand guard. Whoever shoots at us finds out their own arrows come back.
A Letter is not a gift, it's a burden. Choose yours carefully.
Spirit Blood in the veins and nobody gets through. That's how you defend a camp.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.quincy.npc.elder.0: Long ago, the Auswählen chose on its own who would lose their power. Today, only those who yield in a fair duel.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.quincy.npc.elder.1: Vollständig... I saw it once, when I was young. Wings of light covering the whole sky.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.quincy.npc.elder.2: Every Quincy you absorb lives on in you. Honor them: waste no arrow.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.quincy.npc.quincy_: Want to grow, young Quincy? Challenge one of us. If I yield, click me and receive my power — that is the Auswählen.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.quincy.npc.outside: You don't carry the cross... Still, a fair duel deserves a tribute.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.title: Auswählen — the 5 Quincy ranks
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.letter_pick: Choose your Letter in the panel →
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.bonus.1: Swallows 25%% (+5%% per rank) of the projectiles that hit you: they become Focus and Reishi.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.bonus.2: Projectiles that get through deal 15%% less damage.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.bonus.3: Holding the Cross: +25%% Focus; standing still gathers ambient Reishi.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.bonus.4: Quincy techniques gain +4%% power per rank.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.not_quincy: You are not a Quincy: you can learn the techniques from a Quincy player's Lesson, but you don't walk the Auswählen.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.rank_up_tip: All set: the ceremony happens wherever you are.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.guide.1: Quincy camps (white tents with a blue star on the ground) appear in plains, forests and snow. Archers, Sentinels and Elders live there.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.guide.2: Challenge a camp Quincy: nobody dies — below 30%% health they yield. Click them and stay close for 3 s: that is the Auswählen.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.guide.3: Quincy players can give their power too: sneak with the Cross in hand and click your friend; they accept through chat (once per day).
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.guide.4: Absorb projectiles (passive or the Absorption form) and drain enemies to store Reishi; Reishi Return and the Cross's Holy Burst spend it.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.guide.5: Every Quincy technique is a glyph: build them in the Grimoire with any form, effect, stage or element.
tooltip.isekai_mahou.quincy_sanrei_glove: Held: Quincy techniques come out at 70%% power (the weight of training).
Every enemy defeated with them counts toward Quincy: Letzt Stil (rank V).
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_heilig_bogen.d: Quincy FORM (rank IV). After 1 s drawing, a GIANT BOW OF LIGHT opens in front of you and fires a huge central spear-arrow (pierces 4) and a fan of 4 large arrows (pierce 3); +2 arrows per Split. Each arrow is a copy with the effects. Accelerate/Pierce/Homing/Expand apply.
Quincy FORM (rank IV + 80 Letter uses). Five pillars of light fall on the Quincy star at the aimed spot and raise a CAGE of Reishi bars (radius 5, +1.5 per Expand) for 6 s (Extend increases it): enemies inside cannot leave and, every 0.5 s, blades of light SHRED all of them with the effects. Cost: pulses × duration (moderated).
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_antithesis.des: Quincy EFFECT (rank IV + 350 absorptions). INVERTS what happened between you and the target in the last 10 s: you heal the damage you took and the target receives it (up to 60%% of its health, bosses 20%%); the target heals HALF the damage it took and that half moves to you (never lethal). Use it when you are more wounded than the enemy! No wounds: 2 damage.
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_letzt_stil.des: TRANSFORMATION BODY (Quincy; rank V + Sanrei Glove training). Goes inside the Supreme Transformation (G key). For 30 s (Extend on the body increases it) the Quincy unleashes ALL their Reishi: Quincy techniques ×2, Strength II, Speed II, Resistance I, Regeneration I, glides on huge wings of golden light, swallows every projectile within 8 blocks and every 0.75 s a fan of 6 giant homing arrows falls on enemies within 24 blocks (the effects). THE PRICE: when the transformation ends, health at 50%%, Weakness II and 10 minutes WITHOUT QUINCY POWER.
glyph.isekai_mahou.quincy_almighty.desc: TRANSFORMATION BODY (Quincy; rank V + 8 Auswählen + 6 bosses). Goes inside the Supreme Transformation (G key): Supreme Transformation → The Almighty → effects. For 5 MINUTES you SEE THE FUTURE: every attack from a creature is dodged. Whoever attacks you sees you vanish and appear BEHIND them, with a strike and an "I saw it all..." — each counter costs 30 s of the transformation, then 5 s of dodging only (no teleport). 10 counters or the time running out = the transformation ends. Whoever is about to attack you glows and shows its trajectory beforehand. 10 min cooldown.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.burnt.desc: The Schrift sets the target ablaze for 4 s and a flare burns anyone within 2 blocks.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.burnt.passive: Passive: you never burn for more than 2 s.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.jail.desc: The Schrift raises bars of light around the target: Rooted for 2 s (bosses 0.75 s).
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.xaxis.desc: The Schrift pierces the target in a straight line that continues 10 blocks behind it, hurting everything in its path.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.xaxis.passive: Passive: Spirit Bow arrows pierce +1 target.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.balance.desc: The Schrift heals you for 40%% of the damage dealt and passes one of your harmful effects to the target.
quincy.isekai_mahou.letter.balance.passi: Passive: below 50%% health, you take 8%% less damage.
The Schrift poisons: Poison II and Wither for 4 s.
Passive: you are immune to poison.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.almighty_sho: %s opens the eyes of the future: THE ALMIGHTY!
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.tech_learned: New Quincy technique: %s! Put it together in the Grimoire.
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.powerless_st: Letzt Stil burned all your Reishi. You will be without Quincy power for %s minutes.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.tech_how.heil: Comes on its own at Auswählen rank IV.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.tech_how.sank: Comes on its own at rank IV, after using your Letter 80 times.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.tech_how.anti: Comes on its own at rank IV, after 350 absorptions.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.tech_how.letz: Train with the SANREI GLOVE (rank IV or crafting) in hand: weaker techniques, but every kill counts. 150 kills at rank V unlock the final form.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.tech_how.almi: Comes on its own at rank V, with 8 Auswählen and 6 bosses defeated. The eyes of the future.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.tech_tip.heil: Heilig Bogen: assemble it with a damage effect; Split widens the fan.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.tech_tip.sank: Sankt Zwinger: aim at the ground in the middle of the enemies — nobody leaves the cage.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.tech_tip.anti: The Antithesis: put it on a projectile and use it when you are more wounded than the target.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.tech_tip.letz: Letzt Stil: put it in the Supreme Transformation (G key): Supreme Transformation → Letzt Stil. The price is high — 10 minutes without Quincy power.
screen.isekai_mahou.quincy.tech_tip.almi: The Almighty: put it in the Supreme Transformation (G key) and see the future for 5 minutes (or 10 counters).
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.almighty_cou: I saw it all — %s counters left · %s:%s remaining
message.isekai_mahou.quincy.almighty_end: The eyes of the future close.
